Senate Standing Committees on Environment and Communications 

The Environment and Communications Committees cover the following portfolios: Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water, and Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (Communications, Sport and the Arts functions only).

Interactive Gambling Amendment (Gambling Reform) Bill 2026 and National Self-exclusion Register (Cost Recovery Levy) Amendment Bill 2026
Online Safety Amendment (Strengthening Enforcement for the Social Media Minimum Age) Bill 2026
Australia Post retail network
Artificial intelligence and data centres
Extended Producer Responsibility Scheme for Packaging (No Time to Waste) Bill 2026
Triple Zero service outage
Greenwashing
National Cultural Policy
